fields.Appearance: Young, ink-stained, and sleep-deprived, carrying more books than practical supplies.
fields.Backstory: A student found evidence contradicting the central claim of a celebrated professor.
fields.Goals: Verify the discovery and present it without destroying innocent academic careers.

fields.Appearance: Absent-minded and formally dressed, with spectacles repaired in several places.
fields.Backstory: A researcher spent decades on a theory dismissed until recent events proved it dangerously correct.
fields.Goals: Warn authorities and finish the work before opportunists weaponize it.

fields.Appearance: Quiet, precise, and burdened with scroll cases, sealing wax, and cramped handwriting.
fields.Backstory: A scribe noticed official decrees are being subtly altered between copying and publication.
fields.Goals: Preserve authentic records and identify the authority behind the changes.

fields.Appearance: Dusty, soft-spoken, and watchful, with keys to collections most visitors never see.
fields.Backstory: A librarian discovered a supposedly destroyed book repeatedly returning under different titles.
fields.Goals: Understand the book's purpose and prevent reckless readers from activating it.

fields.Appearance: Field-worn rather than academic, with notebooks, specimen jars, and sturdy travel boots.
fields.Backstory: An independent historian abandoned the university to investigate ruins local communities consider sacred.
fields.Goals: Document the past without exploiting its descendants and repair the damage caused by earlier expeditions.
